narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#4085

## Bound contract (not the pass-1 body)

Build from bound lean 5514567780 and synthesis 5515166095. Operator confirmed the all-accept map on 2026-09-02. 2026-09-04 operator: implement remaining children after Wave 3 PRs are 5/5 with no blockers. HITL confirm-or-amend is this xBRIEF's locked candidate taxonomy; David confirms by merging the implementation PR. Do not wait for a separate HITL comment round.

Pass-1 issue body is the original write-up only. Thread: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4099 (lean 5514567780, verified-claims 5515165945, synthesis 5515166095). Worker MUST ingest comments via REST before code (#2143).

## What to build (recut)

1. One user-facing capability index as a **generated view** over registries that already exist (Taskfile graph, dispatch.ts / CLI_MODULE_VERBS, skill pack / help keys, public docs-site pages). A small typed overlay supplies audience, status, gotchas, in-the-public-index. `--check` is wired into `check:framework-source` / `FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES`.
2. A declared-versus-touched PR documentation-impact declaration. Not presence-and-enum on author prose. `no user-doc impact` is refused when a registered command, skill, help key, or public docs-site page is added or removed. Syntactic trigger over tracked paths. Rationale is length-bounded quoted data and never a gate input.
3. Lane: a `pull_request` step that invokes the verifier with the event PR number via existing closing-keywords `--pr` / `--body-file` transport. Fork PRs are read-only against GitHub and do not run with elevated credentials. Local `task check` cannot see a GitHub-only field without `--body-file`.

## HITL candidate taxonomy (locked here; merge = confirm-or-amend)

Closed enums live in the committed overlay after this PR, not only in issue comments.

- audience: `consumer` | `maintainer` | `frozen`  (#4100 consumes this enum)
- status: `current` | `compatibility` | `withdrawn` | `experimental`
- status owners: current = registry owner (Taskfile / dispatch / skill pack); compatibility = dispatch.ts alias owner; withdrawn = same-PR as #447 (pack source, not a drifting render path); experimental = required overlay field `status_owner`
- surface / canonical_entry.kind: `command` | `skill-trigger` | `document` | `none` (typed union)
- change_class: `add` | `change` | `withdraw`
- overlay fields: audience, status, gotchas (quoted, length-bounded, never a gate input), in_the_public_index (boolean), canonical_entry `{kind, id}`, optional status_owner
- membership predicate (not editorial "major"): `in_the_public_index === true && status ∈ {current, compatibility} && canonical_entry.kind !== "none"`
- PR templates: **both** `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` (maintainer) and `content/templates/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` (consumer)
- first delivery: PR declaration + capability-map source/check. Change-class `withdraw` maps to the closed surface set (command / skill / help key / public docs-site page). Do not keep an unevidenced same-delivery-unit content requirement on a presence-only verifier.
- #447 stays the rule body by reference (pack source).

## Why (survives the recut)

Scattered implementation-local docs and a self-clearing presence-only PR checkbox. One generated index plus declared-versus-touched is the control.

## Out of scope

- AGENTS.md / agents-entry growth (do not always-pin the index)
- Parallel RULE-MAP / second command extractor (consume #4087 / #4094 registries if projecting commands)
- Scoring rationale prose
- README/UPGRADING/docs-site IA rewrite (#4100)
- Release-notes as a required AC unless the worker can evidence a detecting event; default is drop release from what-to-build
- #2702 / #3798 as this delivery unit

## Type

HITL — taxonomy is the candidate in this xBRIEF; merge confirms.

## Blocked by

- #4086, #4087, #4091 (Wave 1 landed). HITL taxonomy need not wait on remaining AFK siblings.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want a generated capability index over existing registries and a declared-versus-touched PR check, so that new features and withdrawals cannot omit public docs by writing `no user-doc impact`.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add typed overlay + generator + --check on existing registries. Add declared-versus-touched verifier on both PR templates and a pull_request --pr/--body-file lane. Do not always-pin. Do not mint RULE-MAP. Do not edit README, UPGRADING, docs-site IA, SUPPORT.md, or getting-started.md. 1. Edit swarm.file_scope. 2. Add focused tests. 3. Run verify_commands.

items.title: Lock closed audience/status/surface/change-class enums in a committed overlay; membership is a predicate; #4100 consumes audience.

narrative.Acceptance: When the overlay is read, then audience is consumer|maintainer|frozen, status is current|compatibility|withdrawn|experimental with a named owner, canonical_entry.kind is command|skill-trigger|document|none, and public-index membership uses the predicate, not editorial major.

items.title: Typed overlay on existing registries; generated human page; --check in check:framework-source; no always-pin; no parallel RULE-MAP.

narrative.Acceptance: When the overlay and registries disagree, or the generated page is stale, then the focused --check wired into FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES fails.

When change_class is withdraw, then the closed surface set (command/skill/help key/public docs-site page) is the detecting event, and #447 is referenced rather than duplicated.
